Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for informant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

2. This bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No.04 of 2016, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Nakhasa, District- Sambhal with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and she has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is mother-in-law of deceased.

Only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the accused persons, including applicant.
No specific role has been assigned to the applicant.
It was submitted that deceased has committed suicide on 20.12.2015 due to some dispute with her husband.

In postmortem report, except ligature mark and some minor contusions and abrasions, no other injury has been shown on body of deceased and cause of death has been shown asphyxia as a result of ante-mortem hanging.
The applicant was named in the First Information Report but during investigation, she was exonerated, as no case was found against her.
The charge-sheet was filed against co-accused Rashid, who is husband of deceased.

During trial, applicant and co-accused,
namely, Noor Mohammad, Kasim & Rauf have been summoned by the trial Court under Section 319 Cr.P.C. by order dated 17.08.2022.
4. It was further submitted that similarly placed co-accused Kasim has already been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 26.10.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.44761 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.44761 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is a lady and she is languishing in jail since 09.05.2024,
having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, she will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
5. Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for informant have opposed the prayer for bail but it could not be disputed that similarly placed co-accused Kasim has already been enlarged on bail.

6. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
7. The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant- Smt Rukhsana @ Momina involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i.
The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which she is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which she is suspected.

v.
